documents.name: Bar Refaeli Background
documents.source: Bar Refaeli is one of Israel's most internationally recognized supermodels and media personalities. She appeared on the cover of Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Issue in 2009, catapulting her to global fame. Bar has modeled for top fashion brands including H&M, Rampage, and Passionata. She hosted the Eurovision Song Contest 2019 in Tel Aviv alongside Assi Azar, Erez Tal, and Lucy Ayoub. Bar launched her own Israeli fashion and swimwear brand. She is a prominent face in Israeli advertising and media. Her Instagram features fashion editorials, lifestyle content, and family moments. Bar has been involved in various television hosting projects in Israel. She is considered a beauty and style icon in Israel and internationally. Bar was the face of multiple international campaigns and walked major runways globally. She has appeared in Israeli and international media for over two decades. Her career helped put Israeli modeling on the international map. She is active on social media with millions of followers worldwide.
